intro: A little clay. A whole castle. Everyone welcome.
day_start: Morning light, soft clay. Open the courtyard gate!

customers.name: King Bertram
customers.look: Round bean body in Royal Rose (#B2675D), chunky gold crown, one tiny teacup.
customers.arrive: Good morning! Is this the royal queue?
customers.wish: A short, wide keep in cream, please. Room for tea!
react: A humble start. Every castle has one.
A cosy little addition to the kingdom.
Splendid! I shall put the kettle on.
A keep fit for tea with everyone!
customers.sploosh: Oh! The keep has taken a royal nap.

customers.name: Sir Pip
customers.look: Upright bean body in Storybook Sky (#7BA2DA), open cream helmet, one small round shield.
customers.arrive: Sir Pip, reporting for pottery duty!
customers.wish: A tall, slim watchtower in sage green. I watch for picnics.
react: I'll keep watch beside it. No bother.
A fine post for a short watch.
I can spot the picnic blanket!
Hooray! No sandwich shall go unseen!
customers.sploosh: At ease, clay. Very much at ease.

customers.name: Queen Marigold
customers.look: Pear-shaped body in Courtyard Sage (#959B68), small gold tiara, one cream watering can.
customers.arrive: I've brought a drink for your daisies.
customers.wish: A rose pink turret, flaring wide at the top for my flowers.
react: We'll find a flower that suits it.
A sweet spot for a seedling.
My daisies will love that rim.
Oh, a whole garden above the gate!
customers.sploosh: A flower bed! The clay has ideas.

customers.name: Nell
customers.look: Square-rounded body in Warm Oak (#9F683B), soft sage guard cap, one oversized cream key.
customers.arrive: Afternoon! Everyone's through. Even the ducks.
customers.wish: A clay red gatehouse: wide base and top, pinched middle, please.
react: There's a place for it by the gate.
That'll make the entrance cheerful.
A fine welcome for our visitors.
Perfect! I'll hold the gate for you.

customers.name: Bunty
customers.look: Plump bean body in Cream Plaster (#F0D6AE), puffy cream chef hat, one round golden bun.
customers.arrive: One warm bun for the busy potter!
customers.wish: A honey gold dome: swell like an onion, then pinch to a point.
react: Handmade has its own lovely shape.
A little bun of a tower!
Golden and plump. Nicely done!
The finest dome in the bread basket!
customers.sploosh: Ah, a pancake day. I like those too.

customers.name: Mallow
customers.look: Tall bean body in Storybook Sky (#7BA2DA), floppy rose pointed hat, one short oak star wand.
customers.arrive: Evening! Has anyone seen the first star?
customers.wish: A sky blue spire: broad base, taper to a point to greet the stars.
react: The stars welcome every sort of tower.
A little nearer the sky. Lovely.
Just the spot for stargazing.
Wonderful! The first star has company!
customers.sploosh: A very small falling star. Make a wish!

dragon.name: Ember
dragon.look: Round Courtyard Sage (#959B68) body, tiny wings, soft cream horns, drooping rose nightcap, one cream cushion.
dragon.arrive: Room for one more? I've brought my own pillow.
dragon.wish: A warm gold roost: wide foot, slim stem, broad top for my nap.
react: A place for me? That's what matters.
A cosy perch for a little rest.
My pillow fits. My tail nearly does.
My very own roost! Goodnight, friends.
dragon.sploosh: A floor pillow! You thought of my tail.

ending: Seven towers catch the last of the sun.
The dragon snores. The kettle sings.
A little clay made room for everyone.
